annotations.text:
Axis D: column cards.
Why: Mobile is one card per species (390 wide, 1266 px tall measured), so all 12 values are readable without a tap; Tablet 2-up (715 px); Desktop is the classic 4-column table at 426 px with the African Grey row tinted rgba(45,106,79,.08) and a C.A.Gs pick chip.
Trade-off: the tallest mobile answer of the three (1266 px vs 845 for E and 635 for F); a buyer scrolls three screens to reach Amazon.

Axis E: banded rows.
Why: each trait is a full-width warm band with a 2x2 grid of species under it, so the comparison is trait-first (what buyers scan for); the African Grey cell is tinted green with a check in every band. Same structure at all widths: Mobile 845 px, Tablet 821 px, Desktop 850 px inside a 960px bordered container.
Trade-off: species names repeat three times; the tallest Desktop of the three (850 px vs 426 D, 425 F).

(Recommended) Axis F: accordion rows.
Why: Mobile is three <details> rows (summaries 44px+) whose summary carries the African Grey value inline, so the pick is visible with zero taps at 635 px tall, about half of D (1266) and under E (845); Desktop is a hairline table at 425 px with no vertical rules and a 16px SVG check in the African Grey cell, the lightest of the three.
Trade-off: 8 of the 12 values (Macaw, Cockatoo, Amazon) sit behind a tap on Mobile; only the first row opens by default.

Axis D: column cards.
Why: Mobile is one card per subspecies (390 wide, 1649 px measured) with the price as a 28px Newsreader numeral at the top and the three traits as label:value lines, so every price is readable without a tap; Tablet 2-up (886 px); Desktop is the classic clay-header table at 572 px, zebra warm-bed rows, with the Congo Grey Baby row tinted rgba(45,106,79,.08) and a Top pick chip. Closest to the live PricingTable, so the smallest change for the breeder.
Trade-off: the second-tallest Mobile of the three (1649 px vs 2064 E and 834 F); a buyer scrolls four screens to reach Fertile Egg.

Axis E: banded rows.
Why: each subspecies is a warm-bed band carrying the label left and the price right, with Adult weight, Best fit and Talking ability in a 3-up grid under it (1-up at Mobile), so the price sits on the band the eye lands on first; the Top pick cells are green-tinted. Desktop 1067 px inside a 960px 18px-radius container, Tablet 1016 px, Mobile 2064 px.
Trade-off: the tallest at every width (2064 px Mobile, 1067 Desktop vs 572 D and 570 F); six bands of three cells means 18 trait cells, so the six-row pricing table becomes a long read.

(Recommended) Axis F: accordion rows.
Why: Mobile is six <details> rows (summaries 44px+) whose summary carries subspecies and price, so all six prices read with zero taps at 834 px, half of D (1649) and 40% of E (2064); Desktop is a hairline table at 570 px with no vertical rules and a 16px SVG check on the Congo Grey Baby row, the lightest footprint of the three; Tablet keeps the same table at 606 px.
Trade-off: weight, fit and talking ability are behind a tap on Mobile for five of six rows; only the first row opens by default.
